alert.reason: Level-3 blizzard: SOC line 20% breached in forecast (now 17.8%, min 17.8%); request 50% load cut.

dialogue.text_zh: 三级暴雪缺电预警：SOC 警戒线 20% 将在预报窗内被击穿（当前 17.8%，无需求响应最低 17.8%）。窗内均温 7.3°C、光伏 0.82 kW。请家庭在未来 72 h 削减约 50% 功率（约 0.7 kW）。
dialogue.text_en: Level-3 blizzard: SOC line 20% breached in forecast (now 17.8%, min 17.8%); request 50% load cut.

dialogue.text_zh: 精打细算家长：关闭地暖、拔掉非必要插头保命。冰箱和水井泵留下，烘干机/洗碗机/洗衣机/热水器全部停。估计可削 2.9 kW。
dialogue.text_en: Shut floor heating and unplug non-essentials; keep fridge and well pump.

dialogue.text_zh: 居家办公成员：我可以不烘干衣服、调暗灯光，但我的工作电脑和路由器不能断。洗碗机可推迟。估计可削 1.1 kW。
dialogue.text_en: I can skip the dryer and dim lights, but the work PC and router stay on.

dialogue.text_zh: 妥协：停 Electric_Clothes_Dryer, Dishwasher；地暖设定 -2.5°C；灯光调暗 45%；电脑/路由/冰箱受保护。合约削负荷 1.1 kW。
